# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It rolls up variable fonts, color font palettes, animated WebP encoding, explicit surface sampling, and major lifecycle fixes from the preview line. This is a breaking release: review the font, Vulkan, stream, platform, and obsolete-API migrations before upgrading from v3.

## Breaking Changes

- **SKFont() now uses SKTypeface.Empty** — A parameterless `SKFont` no longer resolves the platform default at draw time: its typeface is empty, measurements return zero, and text is not drawn. Construct it with `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)` and use `font.Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of a null check. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKPaint.Typeface and missing-family fallback semantics changed** — A new `SKPaint` now exposes `SKTypeface.Default` instead of null, and `SKTypeface.FromFamilyName` returns the default face for missing families on every platform. Remove paint typeface null checks; use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily` when a missing family must return null. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now validates the 32-bit native range** — The `long` overload is obsolete and throws `OverflowException` instead of silently truncating offsets outside the native 32-bit range. Validate the value and call `Move(int)`. ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **Ganesh Vulkan now requires Vulkan 1.1** — `GRContext.CreateVulkan` terminates the process for Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null. Create the instance with Vulkan 1.1 or later and set `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` to the same supported version; choose another backend before calling Skia on 1.0-only hardware.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative fields removed** — Remove assignments to `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. Use `fVkExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures` or `fDeviceFeatures2`; Skia no longer owns the Vulkan instance and device through this context.
- **Vulkan YCbCr conversion types and layout changed** — `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` now uses `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`; the old `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` loses value equality, and the layout adds `Components` while replacing legacy format fields. Update type references, comparisons, and manual interop initialization. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Pre-v4 obsolete APIs are compile errors** — Legacy SKPaint text/font state, implicit paint-state drawing overloads, SKTypeface glyph helpers, old run-buffer span methods, sample-count render-target constructors, `SKPaintHinting`, and `SKFilterQuality` are removed from the reference surface. Move text and glyph work to `SKFont`, pass `SKSamplingOptions` and alignment explicitly, and use the documented replacement properties and constructors. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only** — The protected setter is removed. Derived wrappers can no longer change disposal suppression after construction and must use the supported ownership path. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **WASM native assets now require .NET 8** — Native assets for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions are removed. Blazor WASM and Uno Platform WASM projects targeting .NET 6 or .NET 7 now fail at build time; upgrade the WASM target to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Tizen 32-bit native assets removed** — The Skia m147 transition removes the EOL Tizen arm and x86 native builds. Move deployments to the new `tizen-arm64` or `tizen-x64` assets. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Assembly version advanced to 4.x** — `SkiaSharp.dll` now reports assembly version 4.148.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and hard-coded version checks. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))

## Engine

- **Skia advances through m132, m133, m147, and m148** — The first stable v4 engine includes upstream fixes plus CICP color spaces and the single-channel half-float `SKColorType.RF16` format. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, named instances, typeface cloning, palette selection, and per-color overrides. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Bundled codec and font dependencies refreshed** — The release updates libpng, zlib, FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, HarfBuzz, and other bundled native components. ([#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## API Surface

- **SKSamplingOptions for surface and bitmap draws** — `SKSurface.Draw`, `SKCanvas.DrawSurface`, and new bitmap overloads let callers choose filtering and mipmap behavior explicitly. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — `SKWebpEncoder` can encode a span of pixmap-and-duration frames into an animated WebP. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **SKStream.GetData() fast path** — Memory-backed streams can return their ref-counted `SKData` directly without copying; unsupported stream types return null. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **New document, GPU, mask filter, and HarfBuzz APIs** — Adds XPS document options, per-resource GPU flushes, shader-backed mask filters, `HBColor`, and missing HarfBuzz wrappers. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap and SKBitmap pixel spans corrected** — `GetPixelSpan` now uses `RowBytes` for shared-buffer strides and computes coordinates from the correct row width. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **Font and path crashes fixed** — Managed default face resolution avoids the Android API 36 startup crash, NanoServer uses an empty font manager, and SKPath disposal no longer dereferences a finalized builder. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796), [#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835))
- **Variable-font spans and glyph checks corrected** — Undersized variation buffers now report and copy the correct values, while `SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs` no longer recurses until a stack overflow. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Platform view and projection failures fixed** — Android `SKGLView` renders after MAUI tab reattachment, and .NET 9 WinUI apps can load the packaged projection assembly. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton and native-wrapper lifetimes reworked** — Lazy singleton initialization avoids type-constructor cycles, shared native singletons are no longer freed by wrappers, and native calls keep wrappers alive through P/Invoke. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native compatibility checks run at first interop use** — Consumers can configure native-library resolution before SkiaSharp checks the loaded native version. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets** — Adds dedicated x64 and arm64 binaries for `linux-bionic`, `tizen-x64`, and `tizen-arm64`. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple target frameworks realigned** — Libraries target the base 26.0 Apple workloads while apps use unversioned TFMs, avoiding an unnecessary Xcode 26.2 requirement. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Security

- **libexpat updated with 2.8.x security hardening** — The bundled XML parser advances from 2.7.5 to 2.8.1 and picks up the upstream release's security hardening. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library to 14.2.0 and includes variable-font shaping, color font palette APIs, and the `HBColor` value type.
